notes.title: Prepare for an intergalactic battle spectacle in 2026!
notes.notes:
[h3]Hello BVN enthusiasts! 

We promised you an intergalactic battle spectacle, and we have been diligently working towards this goal. But great things take time - so we’ve decided to move [b][u]our release date to 2026[/u][/b] to bring you the best game possible. 

Please look forward to what’s in store leading up to the release, as we have exciting updates that we can’t spill the beans on just yet, but when we do… get ready to GET HYPED!!! 

In the meantime, [b]head to [url="https://discord.gg/yk6hBhpfvw"][u]our Discord[/u][/url][/b] for questions, discussions, and any theory-crafting you might desire. You will be able to chat with other likeminded folk about our other games (shout out to Grindstone)! 

We appreciate and thank you for your patience. It means so much to us whenever we see your enthusiasm for the game. 

Talk to you again soon! 

💙 Capybara Games aka CAPY![/h3][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45050973/e949ab91a7a0f2c0df3e6d76206e528847a4c013.png"][/img][/p]

notes.title: Introducing BVN 101 and our characters!
notes.notes:
Helloooooooo, and thank you so much to everyone who’s supported our announcement! We are ecstatic to introduce [b]BATTLE VISION NETWORK[/b] to all of you 💙 The hype we received for our trailer has been immeasurable and we are so SO grateful. Guess we should show you more!

We’ve been talking about the basics of BATTLE VISION NETWORK in our BVN 101 series on social media! You can check it out on [url=https://www.tiktok.com/@capybara_games?lang=en]TikTok[/url], [url=https://x.com/CAPYGAMES]Twitter/X[/url], [url=https://www.youtube.com/@CapyGamesForYou]YouTube[/url], [url=https://www.instagram.com/capygames/]Instagram[/url], and [url=https://linktr.ee/capygames]everywhere in between[/url]. Here’s a quick summary on what we’ve showcased so far!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45050973/99e78ab335c86f97f4ca697bd8431c13bbbecc43.png[/img]

[b]Color Attacking:[/b] The core of our gameplay! Making vertical matches (3 core units) creates attackers; all of them have their own unique abilities.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45050973/0a49f8886e53e20858cad22180b004c6ee5eb469.png[/img]

[b]Defending:[/b] Making horizontal matches (3+ core units) creates your defense! You can stack them as well.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45050973/470a7a4bbae076c35a141741145d1477fcf7fd2f.png[/img]

[b]Battles:[/b] Players take turns battling it out! In each turn, you get a limited amount of actions. You can create attackers, build up your defense, and score! Another action we’d like to introduce is…

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45050973/ff9c6336c4174433796d8f68820c8004a5c77385.png[/img]

[b]Stars and Super Stars:[/b] Every time you make a match, you gain SP (Star Power)! You can use that to drop in Stars and Super Stars, which are stronger units with incredible abilities. 

We hope these features entice you! Is there one that excites you the most!? 

There is more for us to reveal, but for now… why don’t we introduce you to our cast of characters? We’re slowly rolling out the teams you can support and battle with, so make sure to follow along! We’ll be back with more about our Captains and the fun cast of units behind them ✨ [b]Don’t forget to join us on [url=https://discord.gg/yk6hBhpfvw]Discord[/url] as well![/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45050973/4670c78396f0964cc65dc9ee9877e5311961820e.gif[/img]
